title: North or South?
blurb: Two lions, two traditions. Three questions.
fact: The southern lion is the one you'll almost always see in Singapore — stylised head, decorated cape, and a drum that tells you what the lion is feeling.
credit: Background from the National Heritage Board's Roots ICH entry on lion dance. Art is original.

questions.prompt: Which lion turns up at most Singapore shop openings?
questions.note: The southern lion is far more common here — stylised head, decorated cape.

questions.prompt: How many instruments drive the performance?
questions.note: Drum, gong and cymbals together. The drum leads; the other two answer it.

questions.prompt: Roughly how far back does lion dance go?
questions.note: More than 1,500 years, with roots in Chinese martial performance.
